title: Cost Plus World Market Recalls Daybeds Due to Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard
summary: The removable bottom cushion on the daybed fails to meet the federal flammability standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Emerson Tool Company Recalls RIDGID Wet/Dry Vacuums Due to Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Home Depot
summary: The on/off switch can become dislodged and expose energized wiring, posing a shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 208,000 (in addition, about 2,600 were sold in Canada).

title: Gas Ranges and Wall Ovens Recalled by Prizer-Painter Stove Works Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Use of the convection oven fan during pre-heating or broiling can cause accumulated gas to ignite, posing a burn hazard to consumers when oven door is opened. Units: About 7,100 (In addition, about 2,500 units in Canada).

title: Jimco Recalls Bistro Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's seat can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 16,000.

title: John Deere Recalls Gator Utility Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The powertrain hardware can come loose, causing the throttle to stick. This could result in the operator not being able to stop the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 4,700 (In addition, about 200 were sold in Canada).

title: Lester Electrical Recalls Links Series Chargers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The control board can fail and overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 19,000.

title: TJX Recalls Barstools Due to Fall Hazard; Sold at HomeGoods, Marshalls and T.J. Maxx Stores
summary: The wood joints on the barstool can break; posing a fall hazard. Units: About 1,100 (in addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: Hawthorne Hydroponics Recalls Humidifiers Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: The humidifiers can overheat while in use, posing fire and shock hazards. Units: About 400 (In addition, 70 were sold in Canada).

title: Polaris Recalls Ranger Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front lower control arms can separate, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,000.

title: Rust-Oleum Recalls Countertop Coating Due to Violation of Federal Lead Paint Ban
summary: The countertop coating contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead paint ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 1,800.

title: Boy Story Recalls Action Dolls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The joints on the vinyl dolls can break, creating broken pieces that pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 8,500 (in addition, about 40 were sold in Canada).

title: IKEA Recalls Ceiling Lamps Due to Impact and Laceration Hazards
summary: The glass shade on the ceiling lamp can detach and fall, posing impact and laceration hazards to consumers. Units: About 37,000.

title: Life Fitness Recalls PowerMill Climber Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Electrical arcing can occur if liquid enters the power receptacle at the front of the climbers, resulting in sparking and smoking, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,800.

title: TerraTrike Recalls Adult Tricycles Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The right hand wheel hubmount can bend or break, allowing the user to lose control of the trike, which can result in serious injury or death. Units: 600.

title: Boy Scouts of America Recalls Neckerchief Slides Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The colored enamel on the neckerchief slides contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 110,000.

title: CFMOTO Recalls All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel hose can crack and fuel can leak from the vehicle, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 5,300.

title: Desert Harvest Recalls Reléveum Skin Repair Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirements
summary: The bottles are not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act, posing a poisoning risk if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 1,450.

title: Provata Health Recalls Promotional Activity Trackers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The activity tracker wristbands can overheat while the user is wearing it or when charging, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 30,000.

title: Traeger Grills Recalls Wood Pellet Grills Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Grease can leak from the drip tray, posing a fire hazard. Units: 16100.

title: Woodcraft Recalls Clip-On Adapters for Motorcycle Handlebars Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The adapter plate on the motorcycle handlebars can crack and fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 400.

title: Kaz Recalls Stinger Insect Zappers Due to Shock Hazard
summary: The insect kill grid can detach inside the housing, posing a shock hazard. Units: About 72,000.

title: Titan Recalls Weight Lifting Safety Straps Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The stitching in the strap can come loose causing heavy weights to fall on consumers, posing an injury hazard to the weight lifter. Units: About 970.

title: Weeplay Kids Recalls Children's Coveralls Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The bunny applique on the children's coveralls can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 2,500 (in addition, about 130 were sold in Canada).
